verdict.line: You lose if you stand and auto-trade while Jax's Counter Strike is up and let Relentless Assault ramp; you win if you burst him down with Q-E the moment his E is on cooldown.

brief.thesis: Jax's E (Counter Strike) dodges all incoming basic attacks and reduces AoE damage, so trading autos into it is punished, but Irelia's Q (Bladesurge) is a targeted dash-strike, not a basic attack, so it goes through untouched. The entire lane is a question of whose cooldown is up: his E or your Q/E combo.

theirWindow.when: his E and W (Empower) are both up
theirWindow.what: He baits you into an auto trade, dodges it with Counter Strike, then stuns and follows with an empowered attack. Do not extend an auto exchange here.

yourWindow.when: his E (Counter Strike) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: All-in immediately: E (Flawless Duet) to stun and Mark him, then Q (Bladesurge) to dash in, heal, and refresh Q's cooldown off the Mark.

start.why: The highest-picked, highest-winrate start in this matchup (86.8% pick, 47.4% WR over 1,478 games) — the sustain matters because Jax's Leap Strike lets him force early trades.

boots.why: 79.4% pick and top winrate; flat physical damage reduction blunts both his empowered autos and his Relentless Assault attack-speed ramp.

core.why: Percent-health damage and the on-hit slow let you win extended skirmishes without needing to land a perfect all-in.
Appears in both top build paths (56% and 54.2% WR); lets you split and punish him for not having a real engage tool once Counter Strike is down.
Completes the highest-winrate path (56% over 257 games); the attack speed and magic resist keep your Passive stacks up through his sustained pressure.

situational.when: you want damage mitigation over attack speed against a dive-heavy enemy comp
you're already ahead in lane and want to close out duels faster than the Hullbreaker path allows
the enemy team has heavy crowd control beyond just Jax's Counter Strike
you're the primary dive target in the mid-late game

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror rewards committed, extended melee engagements — exactly the all-in you're taking the instant Jax's Counter Strike goes on cooldown — and its adaptive healing offsets his lack of sustain in the fight.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is both the most-picked (70.4%) and highest-winrate (48%) combo here — Ignite punishes the all-in kills you get by timing your engage to his Counter Strike cooldown, since he has no healing to answer it.

playing.title: Play for Counter Strike's cooldown
playing.detail: Jax's E (Counter Strike, 18/16/14/12/10s CD) is his only stun and his only way to dodge autos. When it's down, he has nothing to punish your all-in.

playing.title: Bladesurge through his dodge stance
playing.detail: Counter Strike dodges basic attacks, not targeted spell strikes — Q (Bladesurge) still lands even while he's stanced, so it's safe to use to reposition or reset.

playing.title: Never stand and auto-trade
playing.detail: His passive, Relentless Assault, gains attack speed on every strike with bonus damage on every third hit — the longer an auto exchange runs, the worse it gets for you. Win fast with spells.

playing.title: Block the empowered auto with charged W
playing.detail: Jax's W (Empower, 7/6/5/4/3s CD) buffs his next attack. When you see it come up, charge W (Defiant Dance) — it reduces physical damage taken while charging and absorbs the hit.

playing.title: Bank Passive stacks before skirmishes
playing.detail: Keep Ionian Fervor stacked going into any trade so you already have the bonus attack speed and on-hit damage live the moment his E is down.

playing.title: Mark before you dash
playing.detail: E (Flawless Duet) stuns and Marks — landing it first means your follow-up Q (Bladesurge) refreshes its own cooldown off the Mark, letting you chain in and out safely.

playing.title: Respect his early Leap Strike
playing.detail: Jax's Q (Leap Strike, 17/14/11/8/5s CD, range 700) closes distance fast at levels 1-3, matching the data's early solo-kill edge for him — don't overextend for CS in this window.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, runes, summoners, and win-rate figures are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch. The cooldown timing, ability interactions, and trade-pattern reasoning are my own tactical read applied to that data.

stats.opponentTip: Try to engage whenever Jax’s Counter Strike (E) is on cooldown. Absorb Jax’s (W) damage with a well-timed [W], while waiting for an opportunity to strike back by keeping your [P] stacks up.
